difficulty: A new optional parameter has to be threaded through three modules on one call chain, so each file is only correct if the other two agree on the new argument.
prompt: We need currency on our invoices. Add an optional `currency` argument to `formatAmount(value, currency)` in src/format.js: when it is given, prefix it (formatAmount(10, "USD") -> "USD 10.00"), and with no currency keep the current "10.00". Thread it through `invoiceLine` and `report` too so a report can be rendered in one currency. Existing calls without a currency must keep working.
reference: Adds a second `currency` parameter to formatAmount and passes it down through invoiceLine and report; output without a currency is unchanged.
